text40:
gog-achievements <VERSION>

Restore earned GOG achievements or
re-lock selected achievements.

Usage:
  gog-achievements <command> [options]

Examples:
  gog-achievements auth login
  gog-achievements games list --search Cyberpunk
  gog-achievements achievements list --game 1423049311

Sign in:
  auth login   Sign in through a native
               GOG window and save login
               securely.
  auth status  Check the saved login
               without revealing tokens.
  auth logout  Remove this tool's saved
               login.
  auth finish  Finish manual sign-in
               from stdin or the
               clipboard.
  auth import  Import an existing
               refresh token through
               stdin.

Browse:
  games list  List owned GOG games.

Achievements:
  achievements list
    List achievements and their unlock
    dates for an owned game.

Local queues:
  queue create    Create a local queue.
                  Achievement flags can
                  be repeated.
  queue add       Add achievements to a
                  local queue. Use
                  --action lock to
                  re-lock unlocked
                  achievements.
  queue remove    Remove selected
                  achievements from a
                  local queue.
  queue set-date  Change the date for
                  selected queued
                  achievements.
  queue show      Read a local queue
                  without network
                  access.
  queue apply     Preview a queue. Use
                  --yes to apply it to
                  GOG.

Checks:
  doctor  Check Node, platform support
          and saved login availability.

Updates:
  self update  Check for a newer CLI
               release, or download and
               install it after
               confirmation.

Output and help:
  (default)        Readable summaries
                   and tables.
  --json           Compact JSON for AI
                   tools and scripts.
  --json --pretty  Indented JSON for
                   inspection.
  --pretty         Readable text (same
                   as the default).
  -h, --help       Show help; add it
                   after a command for
                   its options.

Queue edits are local. queue apply
previews by default; --yes applies
changes to GOG.

More: gog-achievements <command> --help
| README.md
